Barangay Concepcion Dos Annual Barangay Youth Investment Program (ABYIP 2025) — Master Overview & Complete Program Roster:
Document: Official ABYIP Project Brief 2025, Office of the Sangguniang Kabataan, Barangay Concepcion Dos, City of Marikina.
Prepared by: Louie Mari Lampa (SK Chairperson / Chairperson, Committee on Youth and Sports Development).
SK Council Members: Jane Clarice P. Borje, Paulo John De Guzman, Angela L. Piando, Margaret Aimee A. Cadag, Genevie C. Dogello, Vinzcent Kyle R. Lopez, Melvin James Y. Ebuenga.
Implementation Period: January to December 2025.
Target Beneficiaries: Youth aged 15-30 years old from different areas in Barangay Concepcion Dos.
Total Approved ABYIP Budget: Php 2,300,000.00.
The ABYIP 2025 consists of exactly 8 approved projects and activities:
1. Batang Con Dos Inter-Color Basketball League 2025 — Approved Budget: Php 700,000.00. Focus: Sports development, youth friendship, city-level league preparation.
2. Turnover of Sports Equipment — Approved Budget: Php 200,000.00. Focus: Providing sports and training equipment to support student-athletes in schools.
3. Gabi ng Kabataan 2025 — Approved Budget: Php 200,000.00. Focus: Youth gathering to promote unity, friendship, and camaraderie.
4. Edu-Aksyon: School Supply Distribution — Approved Budget: Php 200,000.00. Focus: Distribution of essential school supplies to reduce financial burdens for students.
5. SKcentives 2025 — Approved Budget: Php 150,000.00. Focus: Cash/material incentives to honor academic achievers and motivate youth to strive for excellence.
6. Youth Scholarship Program 2025 — Approved Budget: Php 450,000.00. Focus: Direct educational financial assistance to help underprivileged students cover academic expenses.
7. BasketBottle — Approved Budget: Php 150,000.00. Focus: Environmental waste management; installation of trash bins and dedicated PET bottle recycling bins in schools.
8. Youth Fun Run: Promoting Youth Physical Wellness — Approved Budget: Php 250,000.00. Focus: Health, fitness, physical and mental wellness, and community engagement.
Summary Note: All 8 programs are officially approved by the SK Council under the 2025 ABYIP. There are no other programs funded under this specific investment plan.

SK Concepcion Dos ABYIP 2025 Program 1: Batang Con Dos Inter-Color Basketball League 2025.
Location: Barangay Concepcion Dos.
Implementation Period: January to December 2025.
Background / Rationale: A yearly basketball league for all young aspiring athletes in Barangay Concepcion Dos.
Objective: To develop sports in the Barangay and prepare young athletes for city-level or higher levels of competition.
Target Physical Output: Fostering friendship, camaraderie, and discipline among the youth.
Target Beneficiaries: Youth aged 15-30 years old residing in Barangay Concepcion Dos.
Approved Budget: Php 700,000.00.
Status: Officially approved under the 2025 Annual Barangay Youth Investment Program (ABYIP).

SK Concepcion Dos ABYIP 2025 Program 2: Turnover of Sports Equipment.
Location: Barangay Concepcion Dos.
